text: You charge your phone, ready for the day. You barely use it, yet by afternoon, that battery bar is already looking low.
It feels like magic. You put your phone down, walk away, and it's still losing power. Why does this happen?
You might try closing all your apps, thinking they're the culprits. But even with everything 'off', the drain continues, leaving you confused.
The truth: your phone is a tiny, tireless broadcast station. Apps constantly check for updates, push notifications, and share your location.
This constant, invisible chatter, these tiny pings and updates, happen all the time, silently siphoning power, screen on or off.
So tomorrow, when your battery dips, you'll know it's not a mystery. It's the unseen, always-on system demanding its cut from your pocket.
